context: Asuka lectures on the mind and knowledge.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: psychology lecture; abstract vocabulary spoken naturally.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日は、自己と認識について話します。
lines.en: Today we talk about the self and perception.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 認識って、知識とは違うんですか?
lines.style: soft thoughtful woman voice, gentle warm curious attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: はい。知識は、外から得るものです。
lines.en: Yes. Knowledge is gained from outside.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 認識は、自己の内で起こります。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 自己を知るのは、難しそうですね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm reflective attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 多くの人が、それを求め続けています。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 答えは、明らかになりますか?
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm hopeful attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 完全に明らかになることは、稀です。
lines.style: thoughtful teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: しかし、求める過程に意味があります。
lines.en: But there's meaning in the act of seeking.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured encouraging clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 知識より、その姿勢が大切なんですね。
lines.en: So that attitude matters more than knowledge.
lines.style: moved woman voice, soft warm quiet realization throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ。自己への問いを、続けてください。
lines.style: encouraging teacher voice, soft warm measured gentle clarity throughout
